segments.title: Onboarding is three steps
segments.body: Starting fresh on each build. nightly.5 walks through eight steps; nightly.6 asks where you're coming from, how it should look and a last few choices, and sets the rest from the browser you picked. Sped up: 3.7× on the left, 2.2× on the right.

segments.title: Glass or classic? shows the difference
segments.body: The look step in onboarding, Liquid Glass and then Classic. nightly.5 drew the same preview for both; nightly.6 shows what each one looks like.

segments.title: A tab switches on mouse down
segments.body: Press and hold on Crumbs. nightly.5 waits for the button to come back up; nightly.6 switches the moment it goes down, as Chrome, Safari and Arc do.

segments.title: Clicking the address edits it in place
segments.body: Command bar set to open in the centre, then a click on the address and a few letters. nightly.5 jumps to the middle of the page; nightly.6 edits the field where it is, with suggestions dropping down from it. ⌘L still uses the centre.

segments.title: Unread counts you can read
segments.body: Unread counts switched on in Settings › Tabs. nightly.5 shows a small red badge and keeps "(3)" in the title; nightly.6 draws a calm pill with larger digits and shows the count once. They're now off until you turn them on.

segments.title: ⌘W closes every selected tab
segments.body: Click Lexicon, ⇧-click The Daily Ledger, press ⌘W. nightly.5 closes one tab; nightly.6 closes all three.

segments.title: ⌥↩ opens the address in Split View
segments.body: ⌘L, type an address, press ⌥↩. nightly.5 opens it as an ordinary tab; nightly.6 opens it in a split beside the page you're on.

segments.title: The New Tab row lets go
segments.body: Open a page from the sidebar's New Tab row, then move the pointer to the page. nightly.5 leaves the row looking highlighted; nightly.6 clears it.

segments.title: Site Controls opens next to its button
segments.body: Sidebar on the right, address in the sidebar, a click on the site button. nightly.5 opens Site Controls at the far side of the window; nightly.6 opens it beside the button.

segments.title: Settings search finds "cli"
segments.body: Type "cli" in Settings. nightly.5 lists every setting with "click" in it; nightly.6 leads with the ardia command, highlights the match and follows your selection.
